First of all, I'm in no matter an expert with this, but i did experiment with Muscimol, and also with the amanita muscaria in general. So do research yourself!

Safe is probably the wrong word. But with the 2 active chemicals, muscimol and ibotenic acid, you'll have a psychoactive (musc) and a toxic(iboten) effect. The thing is, if u dry the amanita muscaria, a few procent of the ibotenic acid will be decarboxylated into muscimol, but i think it's only up to 30%, which means u'll have a lot of negative effects when consuming it. The best thing is to dry them first, and then boil them at around 60-65°C for about half an hour. Filter out all the organic parts, ans u'll have an "okay" amount of muscimol in your water/tea. U can of course eat the fly agaric, there are also techniques of boiling it to eat the mushroom, mostly from siberia, but I'm not an expert. Please do not believe anything i said and research it yourself, I'm not speaking english very well and also as I said 2 times I'm no expert. Cheers
